# Cloudflare Observability

Find Cloudflare documentation for logs, traces, analytics, alerts, telemetry export, and dashboards

> Links below point directly to Markdown versions of each page. Any page can also be retrieved as Markdown by sending an `Accept: text/markdown` header to the page's URL without the `index.md` suffix (for example, `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/`).
>
> For other Cloudflare products, see the [Cloudflare documentation directory](https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Cloudflare Observability](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/index.md): Find Cloudflare tools for observability data and workflows.

## Logs

- [Logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/logs/index.md): Query and visualize logs from supported Cloudflare products.
- [Datasets](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/logs/datasets/index.md): Review scope, size, and retention for supported Logs datasets.
- [Log Explorer (Legacy)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/logs/log-explorer/index.md): Store and explore Cloudflare logs in the dashboard.
- [Log Explorer API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/logs/log-explorer/api/index.md): Query and configure Log Explorer via the API.
- [Changelog](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/logs/log-explorer/changelog/index.md): View recent changes to Cloudflare Logs.
- [Example SQL queries](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/logs/log-explorer/example-queries/index.md): SQL queries for traffic, security, and performance analysis.
- [FAQ](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/logs/log-explorer/faq/index.md): Find answers to common questions about Log Explorer.
- [Log Search](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/logs/log-explorer/log-search/index.md): Search and explore stored logs via dashboard or API.
- [Manage datasets](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/logs/log-explorer/manage-datasets/index.md): Enable, disable, or delete Log Explorer datasets.
- [Pricing and managing usage](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/logs/log-explorer/pricing/index.md): Understand Log Explorer billing and usage.
- [SQL queries supported](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/logs/log-explorer/sql-queries/index.md): Review SQL syntax supported by Log Explorer.

## Traces

- [Traces](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/traces/index.md): Inspect production request paths in Cloudflare Observability.
- [Configuration](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/traces/configuration/index.md): Choose how each domain samples, stores, exports, and connects traces.
- [Spans](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/traces/spans/index.md): Understand spans captured as requests move through Cloudflare.
- [Workers tracing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/traces/index.md)

## Alerts

- [Alerts](https://developers.cloudflare.com/notifications/index.md)

## Export

- [Export](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/export/index.md): Export Cloudflare logs and traces to external destinations.
- [Logpush](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/index.md)
- [OpenTelemetry export](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/export/opentelemetry/index.md): Export Cloudflare logs and traces to OpenTelemetry destinations.
- [Export to Axiom](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/export/opentelemetry/axiom/index.md): Send Cloudflare traces and logs to Axiom with OpenTelemetry.
- [Export to Grafana Cloud](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/export/opentelemetry/grafana-cloud/index.md): Send Cloudflare traces and logs to Grafana Cloud.
- [Export to Honeycomb](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/export/opentelemetry/honeycomb/index.md): Send Cloudflare traces and logs to Honeycomb with OpenTelemetry.
- [Export to PostHog](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/export/opentelemetry/posthog/index.md): Send Cloudflare logs to PostHog with OpenTelemetry.
- [Export to Sentry](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/export/opentelemetry/sentry/index.md): Send Cloudflare traces and logs to Sentry with OpenTelemetry.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/observability/pricing/index.md): Understand Cloudflare Observability ingestion and storage pricing.
